changes.comment: The exact optional effect peer moves to 4.0.3, so hosts that install effect must move to 4.0.3: an install pinned to 4.0.1 fails with ERESOLVE under npm and warns under pnpm. The /acp entry's @agentclientprotocol/sdk dependency moves to 1.8.0 (schema v1.25.0), which validates fs/read_text_file's line and limit strictly, so a non-integer value now returns an invalid-params error to the agent instead of reading the whole file.
